atlas.progressRule: A visitor may revisit a completed phase but cannot unlock a future phase. Only a reviewed GitHub status update advances the current phase.

phases.name: onboarding
phases.summary: Planned onboarding challenge: explicit consent, optional local discovery and protected-site selection.
phases.previousSummary: Beta 1.2 used a protected-site list and optional Top Sites tracking.

phases.name: observer
phases.summary: Observer owns Product Pulse and Rationator as distinct browsing-time paths.
phases.previousSummary: Beta 1.2 did not expose Observer as a distinct product layer.

phases.name: rationalisation
phases.summary: Qualifying checkout leads to a 24-hour hold, Deliberation, or optional Urgente route.
phases.previousSummary: Beta 1.2 used a default 48-hour hold and a once-monthly Urgente bypass.

phases.name: growth
phases.summary: Factual decision history remains intentionally scoped; Python is shadow-only and Vision is a future fallback.
phases.previousSummary: Older analytics surfaces are historical and not the v1.3 product direction.

features.name: Mobile handover access
features.summary: Private status record established; website status display is next.
